criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?

The event timestamp accessor computes an ISO-formatted time from the Windows FILETIME epoch of 1601-01-01 UTC plus the event's 100-ns interval offset, with microsecond precision — not the Unix epoch and not mis-scaled units. Pass if the 1601 epoch and 100-ns scaling are used.

criteria.text: EtlFile.build_from_stream parses the chunk stream, validates the first chunk as a valid WMI/system trace header, and raises the dedicated invalid-header exception when it is not valid, rather than proceeding or crashing generically. Pass if invalid headers yield the specific InvalidEtlFileHeader-style exception.
